parameters.description: A handle to the window associated with the drop target.

function.return_type: HANDLE, represents a handle to the drop target object.

function.description: This function checks if the given window handle is a drop target by comparing the return value of get_droptarget_handle function with 0.

function.return_type: HANDLE, represents a handle to the drop target for the current process. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: create_map_from_stream
function.description: This function creates a file mapping object from a given stream and returns the handle to this object.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: This is the input stream from which the file mapping object is created.

parameters.name: map
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the handle of the file mapping object that is created.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the function fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: create_stream_from_map
function.description: This function creates a stream from a memory map. It first maps the file into the address space of the calling process and then queries the memory for basic information. It allocates global memory and copies the data from the mapped file into this global memory. It then creates a stream object that uses an HGLOBAL memory handle to manage its storage.

parameters.name: map
parameters.description: Handle to the file mapping object. The file mapping object must exist prior to the call of this function.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Pointer to an IStream interface pointer. This will be filled with the address of the IStream interface pointer upon successful return.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which is a data type used in Windows to represent error conditions, and warning, success and failure messages. It indicates the success or failure of the function.

function.name: impl_from_IDropTarget
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is used to get the containing record.

function.return_type: DropTargetWrapper* which represents the containing record for the given interface.

function.name: DropTargetWrapper_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches either IID_IUnknown or IID_IDropTarget. If it does, it increments the reference count of the IDropTarget interface and assigns the address of the IDropTarget interface to the ppvObject. If it doesn't, it assigns NULL to ppvObject and returns E_NOINTERFACE.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDropTarget interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface ID to be checked

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE otherwise

function.name: DropTargetWrapper_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the DropTargetWrapper object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDropTarget interface of the DropTargetWrapper object

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment

function.name: DropTargetWrapper_Release
function.description: This function releases the DropTargetWrapper object and decrements the reference count. If the reference count becomes zero, the object is freed from memory.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDropTarget interface of the object to be released

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the object has been released

function.name: get_target_from_wrapper
function.description: This function retrieves the target from a given wrapper, adds a reference to the target, and returns a status code.

parameters.name: wrapper
parameters.description: The wrapper from which the target is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to the target to be retrieved.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and DRAGDROP_E_NOTREGISTERED if the target is not found.

function.name: DropTargetWrapper_DragEnter
function.description: This function is a wrapper for the IDropTarget_DragEnter function. It first retrieves the target from the wrapper, then calls the IDropTarget_DragEnter function on the target, and finally releases the target.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer to the drop target

parameters.name: pDataObj
parameters.description: Pointer to the data object

parameters.name: grfKeyState
parameters.description: Current state of the keyboard modifier keys on the keyboard

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: Structure that contains the cursor coordinates

parameters.name: pdwEffect
parameters.description: Pointer to the effect of the drag-and-drop operation

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, success or failure

function.name: DropTargetWrapper_DragOver
function.description: This function retrieves the target from the wrapper, calls the DragOver method on the target, releases the target, and returns the result.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDropTarget interface

parameters.name: grfKeyState
parameters.description: Current state of the keyboard modifier keys on the keyboard

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: Current cursor coordinates

parameters.name: pdwEffect
parameters.description: Pointer to the effect of the drag-and-drop operation

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function. It can be a success or an error code

function.name: DropTargetWrapper_DragLeave
function.description: This function retrieves the target from the wrapper, calls the DragLeave method on the target, and then releases the target.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is the interface pointer to the drop target.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the result of the function. It returns the result of the DragLeave method or the result of getting the target from the wrapper.

function.name: DropTargetWrapper_Drop
function.description: This function retrieves the target from the wrapper, performs the drop operation on the target, and then releases the target.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface to the drop target

parameters.name: pDataObj
parameters.description: Pointer to the data object

parameters.name: grfKeyState
parameters.description: Current state of the keyboard modifier keys on the keyboard

parameters.name: pt
parameters.description: Structure that contains the cursor coordinates at the time of the drop

parameters.name: pdwEffect
parameters.description: Pointer to the effect of the drop operation

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the drop operation

function.name: WrapDropTarget
function.description: This function allocates memory for a DropTargetWrapper structure, initializes it, and returns a pointer to its IDropTarget interface.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window that the drop target is associated with.

function.return_type: IDropTarget pointer, which represents the IDropTarget interface of the newly created DropTargetWrapper structure.

function.name: get_droptarget_pointer
function.description: This function retrieves a pointer to an IDropTarget interface for a given window handle. It does this by getting a handle to a local memory object, creating a stream from this object, and then unmarshalling the IDropTarget interface from this stream.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: This is a handle to the window for which the IDropTarget interface pointer is to be retrieved.

function.return_type: IDropTarget*. This is a pointer to the IDropTarget interface for the given window handle. If the function fails to retrieve this pointer, it returns NULL.

function.name: RegisterDragDrop
function.description: This function registers the specified window as a potential target for an OLE drag-and-drop operation and marshals the drop target pointer into a shared memory map.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window being registered as a drop target.

parameters.name: pDropTarget
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDropTarget interface on the object that will accept the data.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the window is already registered, it returns DRAGDROP_E_ALREADYREGISTERED. If the function fails, it returns a standard COM error code.

function.name: RevokeDragDrop
function.description: This function revokes the drag-and-drop functionality from a specified window. It releases the drop target and the marshalled drop target, and closes the handle to the drop target map.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window from which the drag-and-drop functionality is to be revoked.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns DRAGDROP_E_INVALIDHWND if the window handle is invalid, DRAGDROP_E_NOTREGISTERED if there is no registration data, and the result of the create_stream_from_map function otherwise.

function.name: OleRegGetUserType

parameters.name: clsid
parameters.description: This is the CLSID of the object.

parameters.name: form
parameters.description: This is the form of the user type name to be retrieved.

parameters.name: usertype
parameters.description: This is the pointer to a location where the function can store a pointer to the user type string.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the function fails, the return value can be E_INVALIDARG, REGDB_E_READREGDB, or E_OUTOFMEMORY.

function.name: DoDragDrop
function.description: This function initiates a drag-and-drop operation, setting up a tracking window, capturing mouse input, and processing messages until the operation is complete. It also handles the ESC key press event to cancel the operation.

parameters.name: pDataObject
parameters.description: Pointer to the data object being dragged

parameters.name: pDropSource
parameters.description: Pointer to the source object initiating the drag-and-drop operation

parameters.name: dwOKEffect
parameters.description: Effects allowed by the source during the operation

parameters.name: pdwEffect
parameters.description: Pointer to the effects of the source, updated during the operation

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns E_INVALIDARG if any of the input pointers are NULL, E_FAIL if the tracking window could not be created, or the return value from the tracking operation otherwise

function.name: OleQueryLinkFromData

parameters.name: dwAspect
parameters.description: The aspect for which the miscellaneous status is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: pdwStatus
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that receives the miscellaneous status.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. S_OK if successful, E_INVALIDARG if pdwStatus is NULL, or other error codes if the function fails.

function.description: This function checks if the provided interface ID matches either IID_IUnknown or IID_IEnumOLEVERB. If it does, it increments the reference count of the interface and sets the ppv pointer to the interface, otherwise it returns an error.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that is being queried

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the interface pointer will be stored if the requested interface is supported

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the interface is supported, otherwise E_NOINTERFACE

function.name: EnumOLEVERB_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of an IEnumOLEVERB interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the IEnumOLEVERB interface whose reference count is to be incremented.

function.return_type: ULONG, which represents the new reference count after incrementing.

function.description: This function releases the IEnumOLEVERB interface and decrements the reference count. If the reference count reaches zero, it closes the registry key and frees the memory allocated to the interface.

parameters.name: iface

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the decrement.

function.name: EnumOLEVERB_Next
function.description: This function enumerates the next OLEVERB structure in a sequence.

parameters.description: Pointer to an interface.

parameters.name: celt
parameters.description: The number of OLEVERB structures to be fetched.

parameters.name: rgelt
parameters.description: Pointer to the fetched OLEVERB structure.

parameters.name: pceltFetched

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if successful, error code otherwise.

function.name: EnumOLEVERB_Skip
function.description: This function skips a specified number of elements in the enumeration sequence.

parameters.description: Pointer to an interface used to enumerate OLE verbs.

parameters.name: celt
parameters.description: The number of elements to be skipped in the enumeration sequence.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call to the function. S_OK indicates success.

parameters.description: Pointer to an IEnumOLEVERB interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, S_OK if the operation was successful

parameters.name: ppenum
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to receive the interface of the newly cloned verb enumeration object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, the return value is S_OK. Otherwise, it is an error code.

function.description: This function allocates memory for a new EnumOLEVERB object, initializes its members, and returns a pointer to its IEnumOLEVERB interface.

parameters.name: hkeyVerb
parameters.description: A handle to a registry key that the function uses to initialize the hkeyVerb member of the new object.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: A value that the function uses to initialize the index member of the new object.

parameters.description: A pointer to a caller-allocated pointer variable that receives the IEnumOLEVERB interface pointer of the new object.

function.name: OleRegEnumVerbs

parameters.name: clsid
parameters.description: This is a reference to the class identifier (CLSID) for which the verbs are to be enumerated.

parameters.name: ppenum
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to an IEnumOLEVERB interface. It receives the interface pointer of the enumeration object that can be used to enumerate the verbs.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the function fails, the return value can be one of the error values like REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG, REGDB_E_KEYMISSING, REGDB_E_READREGDB, OLEOBJ_E_NOVERBS, etc.

function.name: OleSetContainedObject

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.description: This function runs an object if it implements the IRunnableObject interface.

parameters.name: pUnknown
parameters.description: Pointer to an unknown object that may implement the IRunnableObject interface.

function.return_type: DECLSPEC_HOTPATCH, represents the status of the function execution. Returns S_OK if the object does not implement the IRunnableObject interface or the result of IRunnableObject_Run otherwise.

function.name: OleLoad

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface the caller is to use to communicate with the object.

parameters.name: pClientSite
parameters.description: Pointer to the IOleClientSite interface on the object's intended client site.

parameters.name: ppvObj
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the function fails, the return value can be E_OUTOFMEMORY, E_UNEXPECTED, REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG, or REGDB_E_READREGDB.

function.name: OleSave
function.description: This function first transfers the class ID, then asks the object to save itself to the storage. If it is successful, it commits the storage.

parameters.name: pPS
parameters.description: Pointer to the IPersistStorage interface of the object being saved.

parameters.name: pStg
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStorage interface of the storage into which the object is to be saved.

parameters.name: fSameAsLoad
parameters.description: Indicates whether the save operation should be the same as when the object was loaded.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: OleLockRunning
function.description: This function locks or unlocks a specified object for the running object table and determines whether the object is closed when it is no longer running.

parameters.description: Pointer to the IUnknown interface on the object that is to be locked or unlocked.

parameters.description: Determines whether to lock the object (TRUE) or unlock the object (FALSE).

parameters.description: If TRUE, when the last lock on the object is unlocked, the object's UnLockRunning method is called with the fLastUnlockCloses parameter set to TRUE.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. S_OK indicates success and other values indicate failure.

parameters.description: The thread identifier that is used to search for a matching entry in the hook_list.

function.return_type: OleMenuHookItem pointer. It represents the hook item in the hook_list whose tid matches the input tid. If no match is found, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: code

parameters.name: wParam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information

function.name: OLEMenu_GetMsgProc
function.description: This function processes messages for OLEMenu. function.name: give_feedback
function.description: This function provides feedback based on the current drag and drop operation. It sets the cursor type based on the drop effect and calls the IDropSource_GiveFeedback function.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a TrackerWindowInfo structure that contains information about the current drag and drop operation.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function execution. It returns the result of the IDropSource_GiveFeedback function call.

function.name: OLEDD_TrackStateChange
function.description: This function tracks the state changes in a window, specifically for drag and drop operations. It checks if the mouse is over a new window, and if so, it initiates a drag enter operation. It also gives feedback and handles the end of a drag operation.

parameters.name: trackerInfo
parameters.description: A pointer to a TrackerWindowInfo structure that contains information about the window and the current drag and drop operation.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: OLEDD_GetButtonState
function.description: This function gets the state of the keyboard buttons and returns a DWORD value representing the state of specific keys (Shift, Control, Alt, Left Button, Right Button, Middle Button).

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: DWORD, represents a bitmask of the state of specific keys. Each bit in the mask corresponds to a specific key (Shift, Control, Alt, Left Button, Right Button, Middle Button).

function.name: OLEUTL_ReadRegistryDWORDValue
function.description: This function reads a DWORD value from the registry using the provided registry key. The value is then stored in the provided DWORD pointer.

parameters.name: regKey
parameters.description: This is the registry key from where the DWORD value is read.

parameters.name: pdwValue
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a DWORD where the read value from the registry will be stored.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value but modifies the DWORD pointed by the pdwValue parameter.

function.name: OleDraw
function.description: This function is used to draw a representation of an object onto a specified device context.

parameters.name: pUnk
parameters.description: Pointer to the IUnknown interface of the object to be drawn.

parameters.name: dwAspect
parameters.description: Specifies the aspect to be drawn.

parameters.name: hdcDraw
parameters.description: Handle to the device context where the drawing should occur.

parameters.name: rect
parameters.description: Pointer to a RECT structure containing the rectangle used for drawing.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK on success, E_INVALIDARG if the pUnk parameter is NULL, and DV_E_NOIVIEWOBJECT if the object does not support the IViewObject interface.

function.name: OleTranslateAccelerator
function.description: This function translates accelerator keystrokes for OLE in-place objects.

parameters.name: lpFrame
parameters.description: Pointer to the frame window in which the object is being in-place activated.

parameters.name: lpFrameInfo
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure that contains accelerator information.

parameters.name: lpmsg
parameters.description: Pointer to the message that may be an accelerator keystroke.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. Returns S_FALSE if the keystroke was not an accelerator, otherwise returns the result of IOleInPlaceFrame_TranslateAccelerator.

function.name: OleCreate
function.description: This function creates a new object of the class associated with the specified CLSID, and initializes the object from the specified storage object according to the specified options.

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: The CLSID associated with the data and code that will be used to create the object.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: A reference to the identifier of the interface to be used to communicate with the object.

parameters.name: renderopt
parameters.description: Specifies whether the object is to be rendered when it is being loaded, and if so, how the rendering is to occur.

parameters.name: pFormatEtc
parameters.description: A pointer to a FORMATETC structure that defines the format used for the rendering.

parameters.name: pClientSite
parameters.description: A pointer to the IOleClientSite interface on the object's container.

parameters.name: pStg
parameters.description: A pointer to the IStorage interface on the storage object from which the object is to be initialized.

parameters.name: ppvObj
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the function fails, the return value can be one of the error values from the CoCreateInstance function.

function.name: OleGetAutoConvert
function.description: This function retrieves the CLSID of the object that the input object is set to automatically convert to.

parameters.name: clsidOld
parameters.description: The CLSID of the object that is set to automatically convert.

parameters.name: pClsidNew
parameters.description: Pointer to where the function writes the CLSID of the object to which the input object is set to automatically convert.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. S_OK indicates success and any other value indicates failure.

function.name: OleSetAutoConvert
function.description: This function sets the CLSID of the object that will be used for automatic conversion of the object identified by the input CLSID.

parameters.name: clsidOld
parameters.description: This is the CLSID of the object that needs to be converted.

parameters.name: clsidNew
parameters.description: This is the CLSID of the object that will be used for automatic conversion.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the operation. S_OK indicates success and any other value indicates failure.

function.name: OleDoAutoConvert
function.description: This function automatically converts a storage object to a new class, if a conversion handler is registered for the original class of the object.

parameters.name: pStg
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStorage interface on the storage object that needs to be converted.

parameters.name: pClsidNew
parameters.description: Pointer to the CLSID of the new class. If the function is successful, the identifier of the new class is written to this location.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the function fails, the return value can be one of the standard HRESULT values.

function.name: OleIsRunning
function.description: This function checks if the OLE object is currently running or not.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: This is the OLE object that the function checks.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the OLE object is running, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: OleNoteObjectVisible
function.description: This function is used to lock or unlock an object for external connections based on the visibility flag.

parameters.name: pUnknown
parameters.description: Pointer to the object to be locked or unlocked.

parameters.name: bVisible
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether the object should be visible or not.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the operation. S_OK indicates success and other values indicate failure.

function.name: PropSysAllocString
function.description: This function allocates a new string and copies the input string into it.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: This is the string that will be copied into the newly allocated string.

function.return_type: BSTR, which represents the newly allocated string that contains the copied input string.

function.name: PropSysFreeString
function.description: This function frees a previously allocated string.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: This is the string that will be freed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: OleQueryCreateFromData
function.description: This function queries whether an object can be created from the data object. It checks for various clipboard formats and returns appropriate status based on the formats found.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the data object to be queried

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the object can be created, OLE_S_STATIC if only static formats are available, and S_FALSE if the object cannot be created.

function.name: init_fmtetc
function.description: This function initializes the FORMATETC structure with the provided parameters.

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: Pointer to the FORMATETC structure to be initialized

parameters.name: cf
parameters.description: Clip format to be set in the FORMATETC structure

parameters.name: tymed
parameters.description: Target device medium to be set in the FORMATETC structure

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: get_storage
function.description: This function retrieves the storage of a data object, checks for different formats, and saves the storage if possible.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the data object to get storage from.

parameters.name: stg
parameters.description: Pointer to the storage to be retrieved.

parameters.name: src_cf
parameters.description: Pointer to the source clipboard format.

parameters.name: other_fmts
parameters.description: Boolean flag indicating whether other formats should be checked.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns the result of the operation.

function.name: OleCreateFromDataEx
function.description: This function is used to create a new object from the data provided and initializes the object's cache.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the data object from which to create the object

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface that the caller is to use to communicate with the object

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Specifies whether the object is created from a link object or another kind of object

parameters.name: renderopt
parameters.description: Specifies whether to render the data on load or on demand

parameters.name: num_cache_fmts
parameters.description: Number of FORMATETC structures in the cache_fmts array

parameters.name: adv_flags
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of advisory flags

parameters.name: cache_fmts
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of cache formats

parameters.name: sink
parameters.description: Pointer to the IAdviseSink interface on the advise sink

parameters.name: conns
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of DWORD tokens that represent the advise connections

parameters.name: client_site
parameters.description: Pointer to the IOleClientSite interface on the object's client site

parameters.name: stg
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStorage interface on the storage object

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in iid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call, success or the error that occurred

function.name: OleCreateFromData
function.description: This function creates a new object from the data provided and returns the result.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the data object from which the object is created

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface

parameters.name: renderopt
parameters.description: Options for rendering the data

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: Pointer to the format in which the data is rendered

parameters.name: client_site
parameters.description: Pointer to the client site where the object is to be created

parameters.name: stg
parameters.description: Pointer to the storage to be used for the object

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the created object is returned

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, success or the error occurred

function.name: OleCreateLinkFromData
function.description: This function creates a linked object from a data object and initializes it.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the data object from which to create a linked object.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface the caller uses to communicate with the resulting linked object.

parameters.name: renderopt
parameters.description: Specifies the drawing options.

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: Pointer to a FORMATETC structure that defines the format, medium, and target device to use for the presentation data.

parameters.name: client_site
parameters.description: Pointer to the IOleClientSite interface on the container site where the linked object is to be placed.

parameters.name: stg
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStorage interface on the storage to be used for storing the linked object.

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in iid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call, success or an error code.

function.name: OleCreateStaticFromData
function.description: This function creates a new static object from data provided in a specified format. It is used in OLE (Object Linking and Embedding) to create a static object from a data object.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the data object from which to create the static object.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface the caller is to use to communicate with the resulting object.

parameters.name: renderopt
parameters.description: Specifies the drawing option. It controls whether and how the object handler should draw the object.

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: Pointer to a FORMATETC structure that defines the format, medium, and target device to use for the presentation data.

parameters.name: client_site
parameters.description: Pointer to the IOleClientSite interface on the container application's client site object.

parameters.name: stg
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStorage interface on the storage object in which the object is to be saved.

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in iid.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the function fails, the return value can be one of the standard return values or one of the specific return values.

function.name: OleCreateFromFileEx
function.description: This function creates a compound document object from a file and provides the caller with an interface pointer to this new object.

parameters.name: clsid
parameters.description: Class identifier (CLSID) of the object

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Pointer to the name of the file from which the object is to be created

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface that the caller wants to use to communicate with the object

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Controls aspects of the object creation

parameters.name: renderopt
parameters.description: Specifies whether the object is to be rendered when it is loaded

parameters.name: num_fmts
parameters.description: Number of elements in the array pointed to by fmts

parameters.name: adv_flags
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of advisory flags

parameters.name: fmts
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of structures that specify the formats to be used for presentation data

parameters.name: sink
parameters.description: Pointer to the IAdviseSink interface on the advise sink

parameters.name: conns
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of token numbers

parameters.name: client_site
parameters.description: Pointer to the IOleClientSite interface on the container's client site

parameters.name: stg
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStorage interface on the storage to be used for the object

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in iid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call to the function. It can be a success or an error code

function.name: OleCreateFromFile
function.description: This function creates a compound document object from a file and returns an interface pointer to the new object.

parameters.name: clsid
parameters.description: Class identifier (CLSID) of the object

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Pointer to the name of the file from which the object is to be created

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface that the caller wants to use to communicate with the object

parameters.name: renderopt
parameters.description: Specifies whether the object is to be rendered when it is loaded

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: Pointer to a FORMATETC structure that defines the format, target device, aspect, and medium that will be used for future rendering of the object

parameters.name: client_site
parameters.description: Pointer to the IOleClientSite interface on the container site where the object is to be created

parameters.name: storage
parameters.description: Pointer to the IStorage interface on the storage object where the object is to be stored

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in iid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. Returns S_OK if the function was successful, or an error value otherwise

function.name: OleDuplicateData
function.description: This function duplicates the data from a source handle to a destination handle based on the specified format and flags.

parameters.name: hSrc
parameters.description: This is the source handle from which data is to be duplicated.

parameters.name: cfFormat
parameters.description: This is the format in which the data is to be duplicated.

parameters.name: uiFlags
parameters.description: These are the flags that determine the behavior of the duplication process.

function.return_type: HANDLE. This is the handle to the duplicated data. If the function fails, the return value is NULL.
